issues.where: illuminated left and lower-left planetary limb
issues.what: The warm surface ends at a harder, speckled edge with less continuous blue atmospheric bloom.
issues.fix: Smooth the surface-side speckle and widen and soften the cyan falloff.

issues.where: crops B, D and H, illuminated planetary limb
issues.what: The harder, mottled edge is evident at native scale and stars remain too conspicuous close to the rim.
issues.fix: Restore the continuous atmospheric gradient and fade star points into the glow.

issues.where: sky above the pole and along both sides
issues.what: Star points are coarser and more diffuse, with more conspicuous scatter near the upper limb and mottled galactic texture at the margins.
issues.fix: Use finer star points and recover the target’s faint galactic structure against deep blacks.

issues.where: crops B, C, E, H and I, sky and dark right limb
issues.what: Stars are puffier and the faint blue streaks and relief inside the dark right limb are muted.
issues.fix: Reduce star bloom and restore faint blue detail without lifting the night-side blacks.

issues.where: crops A, F and G, central canyon, nearby craters and moon
issues.what: Some edges and crater rims have a traced quality and moon pit texture is slightly softer and grainier.
issues.fix: Recover natural variations in edge relief and pit contrast without moving the silhouettes.

issues.what: Amber-brown haze rises higher and stars are larger and softer than in the target’s cooler, darker sky.
issues.fix: Lower and cool the left horizon haze, tighten star points and retain the golden right-hand horizon.

issues.where: central basin and lower-right shadowed shelves
issues.what: Warmer, lifted shadows and more continuous dust reduce separation between ledges and the basin floor.
issues.fix: Restore cooler, deeper blacks and break up the dust veil between ledges.

issues.where: crops B, C and I, sky and horizon
issues.what: Soft, enlarged star dots and thicker amber haze are more obvious in the crops.
issues.fix: Match the smaller star profiles and quicker fade from horizon glow into space.

issues.where: crops A, D, E, F, G and H, basin and foreground cliffs and shelves
issues.what: Dark tonal separation falls in the basin and some fine rock strata and terrace edges are softer.
issues.fix: Undo the warm shadow lift and restore local strata and ledge contrast without sharpening the dust.
